questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you to drive carefully when wet conditions make the road slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may use this lane.
questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead.

questions.question: You may continue carefully through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue carefully through it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. It reserves the lane for buses and vehicles with a driver and the required number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: A bicyclist who doesn't obey traffic laws:

options.text: Is correct because bicyclists don't have to follow traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bicycle taken away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be ticketed.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights, duties, and responsibilities as drivers of motor vehicles. Bicyclists who don't follow traffic laws can be ticketed.

questions.question: You should signal to turn ____ before you start your turn.
questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: Signal to tell other drivers you plan to change lanes or turn. Use your signal at least 100 feet before you make the turn. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road ahead.
You can pass only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. Drivers must follow the rules on regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road ahead go first.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, keep at least ____ between your vehicle and the one ahead.
questions.correctAnswerText: Three seconds
questions.explanation: More distance gives you more time to react. Keep at least three seconds of distance in normal weather and traffic. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: Which of these guide drivers into the correct lanes for turning on some highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: Arrows show which lanes to use for specific purposes, like driving straight or turning.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway. Children are playing nearby. What should you do first?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so children will hear you.
Get out and check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to move away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out and check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Look through your back window when backing up. Don't rely only on mirrors, especially near children. Get out and check behind your vehicle before backing out of a driveway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive slower than the speed limit?

options.text: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic
When there is heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly and blocking the normal flow of traffic is illegal. You can get a ticket for this.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic travels in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make space for vehicles entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over one lane.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing bicycles. A cyclist may have to swerve into traffic to avoid objects on the road. Always drive carefully around cyclists.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Let the motorcycle use a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Let the motorcycle use only half a lane.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the motorcycle use a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full-size vehicle with the same rights as other vehicles. Give motorcycles a full lane width. Even though there may seem to be room in one lane for both a large vehicle and a motorcycle, the motorcycle needs space to maneuver safely.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car coming from the right.
The car coming from the left.
The car whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car coming from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control devices, drivers must yield to vehicles coming from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle:

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because oncoming traffic is unlikely.
By driving on the highway shoulder.
When your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Never pass on hills or curves because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Never pass across a solid yellow line.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, when should you signal?

options.text: Early enough so others know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so others know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers have time to know what you plan to do.

questions.question: In bad weather, increase your following distance to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Four or five seconds.
questions.explanation: More distance between vehicles gives you more time to react. In bad weather and heavy traffic, keep at least four or five seconds of distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest driving season.
Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are the best choice for winter driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or similar bad conditions. Winter is the hardest driving season and requires extra care. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires improve traction on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards and road conditions. This sign warns that an intersection is coming.
